product_one_liner.value: Hover turns smartphone photos into interactive 3D property models that construction professionals, insurance experts, and homeowners use to measure, design, and scope improvement projects.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index shows product updates, customer stories, and contractor/homeowner content rather than a qualifying engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Public developer portal includes API reference material and multiple integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting for Senior or Staff Computer Vision Engineer.

model_provider.value: Hover's custom GenAI, alongside Stable Diffusion, Realistic Vision, Metric3D, OneFormer, MLSD, and NormalBAE.
model_provider.notes: The disclosure names these technologies in development, validation, and conditional-control workflows; it does not establish that every model runs in every product request.

last_funding.notes: Latest listed financing was completed February 19, 2026; this was debt financing, not an equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The February 19, 2026 debt financing falls within the window; the SEC investment schedule also records Hover loan investments dated February 19, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Sales Development Representative (SDR) posting with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: The July 24, 2026 Enhance announcement introduces AI-generated photorealistic designs from a project's 3D model.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tali Leff's profile lists her start as Hover's VP, Marketing in April 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Lead GTM Systems Engineer posting explicitly identifies these tools as part of Hover's GTM stack.
